date_semantics.node_origin_year: when the thing itself was introduced (method/base-method/cited-work year, publication year for articles); null if unknown
date_semantics.node_first_seen_year: publication year of the earliest corpus paper mentioning it
date_semantics.node_last_seen_year: publication year of the latest corpus paper mentioning it
date_semantics.edge_year: year the fact holds — the row's own year (eval/claim) or the asserting paper's publication year
date_semantics.provenance_article_year: publication year of the paper asserting the edge
date_semantics.provenance_ingested_at: when the PDF entered MVKG (article nodes)
date_semantics.provenance_extracted_at: when the extraction pipeline finished (article nodes)
date_semantics.sanity: years outside 1900-2100 dropped as extraction noise
